title: Add a session event when network emulation settings change
body:
### Problem Description

An app has several windows sharing a session. When one window toggles network emulation, the others cannot observe that transition through an event.

### Proposed Solution

Add a session network-emulation-changed event containing offline, latency and throughput values. This is a new API request.

### Alternatives Considered

Forwarding a separate application IPC message manually.
